title: Wake up, the World Changed
overview: After going to sleep wearing a strange amulet, Mo Fan awakes in a world where everything is similar, except that magic exists. Mo Fan is determined to get into Magic High School so that he can protect his family. The trouble is that he has only known about magic for a few months, but everyone else has been studying it for years!

title: The Release of The Seal
overview: Mo Fan awakens to his Magic Elements and begins to cultivate them. Discrimination against Mo Fan and his family continues.

title: Magic Release Assessment
overview: At the Magic High School exams, The Mu family tries to sabotage Mo Fan's practical score and get him expelled.

title: Cultivation Magic Devices
overview: Mo Fan does well in the Magic Exams and is put in the advanced class, where they are loaned training acceleration tools, however his amulet causes more trouble.

title: Xuefeng Mountain Experience
overview: The advanced class goes on magic field training in the mountains. The training doesn't go to plan.

title: Impossible Task to Finish
overview: The advanced class panics as the training exercise goes seriously wrong. Only a few keep their heads.

title: City Hunting Demon Team
overview: MO Fan needs money, so he applies for a job on a monster hunting team.

title: Confrontation
overview: The monster hunters confront a monster that has been terrorizing a girl's school.

title: One-Eyed Wolf
overview: A one eyed wolf has shown up in the city and is eating refugees. Is this one too much for the monster hunters?

title: Fine Soul Acquired, Evolution
overview: The City hunters continue to battle the one-eyed wolf. They can hold it for now, but for how long?

title: Banquet
overview: Mo Fan attends the coming of age party for the Mu family ace, in preparation for their upcoming duel.

title: Magic Duel! Mo Fan VS Yu Ang
overview: The duel between Mo Fan and the young Mu Family ace, Yu Ang. Of course, you know the Mu family won't fight fair!
